title: b1bc.7: DKIM signing in NntpQueue::drain_once
description:
What: In crates/smtp/src/queue.rs, insert DKIM signing between inject_source_header and the post_article call inside drain_once.

Algorithm (inside drain_once, after inject_source_header produces ):
1. Check if self.dkim_signer is Some(signer):
   a. Call signer.sign(&article_bytes) — returns Result<Signature, DkimSignError>.
   b. On Ok(sig): call sig.to_header() to get the full 'DKIM-Signature: ...\r\n' string.
      Prepend it to article_bytes: create new Vec<u8> = header.as_bytes() + article_bytes.
   c. On Err(e): log warn!('DKIM signing failed, deferring article {}: {e}', message_id);
      continue to next file (skip this article — it will be retried on next drain cycle).
2. If self.dkim_signer is None, use article_bytes as-is.
3. Call post_article with the (possibly signed) article bytes.

Defensive programming:
- Never send an unsigned article when dkim_signer is Some — always hold on failure.
- warn! log must include message_id but NOT any message body content.
- DKIM-Signature header prepended before all other headers (standard placement: first header).
- No unwrap() — all Err paths are handled.

Tests (oracle: RFC 8463 Appendix A test vector):
- test_dkim_signing_prepends_header: sign a known test message with a test ed25519 keypair; verify output bytes start with 'DKIM-Signature:'.
- test_dkim_signing_header_format: verify the signed output contains 'v=1' and 'a=ed25519-sha256' in the DKIM-Signature header.
- test_dkim_signing_absent: with dkim_signer=None, verify article bytes are passed through unchanged.
